scope: the controlled latency fault worked and remained availability-clean, but the alert did not fire; the router was restored to stable and no successful alert receipt was written
root_cause: Prometheus canonicalized the exposed 2.500 histogram boundary to the stored label value 2.5, while the rule selected le=2.500 and therefore matched no bucket series
remediation: select the canonical Prometheus label le=2.5 in both 30 second and 2 minute burn-rate windows
